line.name: Rare Leaf
line.description: A separate, distinct Aganorsa Leaf line from 'Rare Leaf Reserve' (which is already on the site) despite the closely related name/branding. Per Aganorsa's own site, sold in two wrapper expressions with their own vitola sets.

research_notes: Not on the site at all under this name - only 'Rare Leaf Reserve' is listed. Our Mac photo 'AganorsaLeaf_Rare-Leaf_Corojo_01.jpg' (found misplaced in the 'Aniversario Corojo' folder) belongs to this separate 'Rare Leaf' (non-Reserve) line, not Rare Leaf Reserve - flagged for the user to re-verify/relabel that photo.
